entries.name: Dion Tyrone Diamond

expected.charges: Disturbing the peace after speaking to students at Southern University; an initial criminal-anarchy charge was dropped
expected.sentence: Served sixty days in jail; the criminal-anarchy charge was dropped.

updates.sentence: Held for 59 days under a $7,000 bond on the criminal-anarchy charge, according to the February 25, 1964 SNCC Student Voice. Released in March 1962; exact day unverified. The later sixty-day term following the unsuccessful appeal was served separately in 1964.

entries.rationale: Separate the 59-day initial Louisiana detention reported by SNCC February25,1964 from the later sixty-day term ending May6,1964. LDF April17,1963 release establishes March1962 release month, not exact day. Do not calculate release date from duration.
